name: Rumali Roti Roll
steps: Knead both flours with yogurt, water and 2 g salt until soft and elastic. Cover for 20 minutes, then divide into four balls.
Roll each ball as thin and wide as possible. Cook briefly on a very hot wide tawa, flipping when small bubbles appear; keep the pliable rumali rotis covered in a clean cloth.

Heat oil; stir-fry sliced onion and pepper for 3 minutes. Add ginger-garlic, chilli, garam masala, remaining salt and paneer strips; toss 4–5 minutes until paneer is hot and the vegetables retain a little bite.
Spread each soft roti with 20 g chutney; divide the hot paneer filling among them, sprinkle lemon juice and fold into four rolls.
tips: Cook rumali roti only until set; overcooking makes this very thin bread brittle.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
